name: Demo I2: Move-Like Redline Tag
description: Exercise a move-like redline operation using a disposable tag target: create a bounded tag, prove it is visible, dry-run move, apply move, verify the model-space delta, and clean it up.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view that supports tagging the configured element id.
Use a taggable target element in the same view so repeated live runs create, move, and delete only disposable tag elements.
success_criteria: A disposable tag id is created in the requested view for the requested target element.
The created tag id is visible in the pre-move visible-element inventory.
The /revit/move-elements dry-run returns effect evidence covering the created tag id.
The applied /revit/move-elements response returns effect evidence covering the created tag id.
The post-move visible-element inventory still contains the created tag id at the requested model-space delta.
A deterministic move visual gate artifact passes using before/after capture evidence.
The created tag is cleaned up with native dry-run and applied delete effect evidence.
failure_criteria: The tag target is not created or is created in the wrong view.
The move dry-run omits the tag id from effect evidence.
The applied move response omits the tag id from effect evidence.
The tag is not visible after move or moves by the wrong vector.
The cleanup delete dry-run/apply omits the tag id from effect evidence.
The move visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
grader_notes: This task extends non-text redline mutation coverage from tag delete to tag move.
Do not count requestedIds-only move or cleanup responses as evidence; move must return movedIds/ids/impactedIds and cleanup must return ids/deletedIds/impactedIds.
